Disney Appoints First Chief Technology Officer

Walt Disney has appointed Karandeep Anand as its first Chief Technology Officer (CTO), effective October 2. Anand most recently served as CEO of the generative AI chatbot service Character.AI. His appointment comes as the media industry faces disruption from artificial intelligence and consolidation.
